purpose: Test the specific mechanistic hypothesis that P2E18's systematic Reference retry advice at refined substeps is caused by holding a balance-rate convergence tolerance fixed while dt decreases, which shrinks the implied integrated balance convergence scale toward floating-point resolution.

falsification.hypothesis_supported_if: The invariant-integrated policy materially restores route validity at refined levels, in particular the 8- and 16-substep levels needed by REF-HIGH, without changing any physical request.
falsification.hypothesis_rejected_if: 8- and 16-substep Reference routes remain systematically retry-advised or otherwise invalid under the invariant-integrated policy.

output_scope: typed integrated mass residual when available
forbidden: No adjustment of the 10 percent P2E14 stability rule
next_if_supported: Preregister a separate P2E19 corrected REF-HIGH qualification using this unit-invariant balance-rate rule and the already frozen 8-versus-16 stability criteria.
